## Patch release: bug fix

- **New records land on the right shelf.** Automatic filing used to put a new task or note on the most specific shelf that any single word of it matched, so words like "needs", "settings" or "records" could put software work on game shelves. Moah now picks the shelf the record really supports: shelf names and phrases count more than single words, and the project's own shelves and the record's links weigh in. When the evidence is too thin, the record stays unfiled and the daily tidy-up files it later.
- **Everyday words no longer file records.** Single everyday words such as "after", "need" or "next" don't count as shelf keywords any more. The daily tidy-up takes them off your shelves, and shelves no longer learn them. Phrases like "how we work" stay.
- Records filed on the wrong shelf before this update stay where they are. Ask your agent to move them.
